scenes.name: Astro Palette
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Astronaut line art on a transparent cutout with live palette swatch cards (background, color0..color15 and foreground, with labels and hex codes).

scenes.name: Astro ASCII
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: ASCII-art astronaut that keeps its original glyph colors and adds a soft foreground tint, with the same live palette swatch cards.

scenes.name: ASCII Astro
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Refined ASCII render based on astro-ascii/base2.jpg, with the same system and live palette swatch cards.

scenes.name: Matrix Rain
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Palette-driven glyph rain ported from the ColorRain effect of @xscriptor/xbackgrounds: one glyph per column over a fading trail, stepped per cell so the characters stay crisp, with colors from workspaceActive and color1..6.

scenes.name: Kanji Rain
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: The matrix-rain effect with a Japanese and Chinese glyph pool plus the letter X, in the palette colors (requires a CJK font, noto-fonts-cjk).

scenes.name: Cartesian Veil
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: A faint cartesian plane filling the screen: symmetric sample points on a damped even function, a smooth Catmull-Rom curve that reveals itself through them, and the formula centred below. Thin lines, distinct palette colours.

scenes.name: Asymptote Veil
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: The graph of f(x) = 1/x drawn towards its limits: dashed asymptotes on both axes, mirrored branches that slow down as they approach x = 0, and the formula and limits centred below.

scenes.name: Fourier Synth
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: A square wave rebuilt from its odd harmonics: the first four components, the partial sum sharpening as N grows, a 1/n spectrum and the formula.

scenes.name: Lissajous Orbit
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Parametric Lissajous curves: ghost ratios, a glowing head tracing the active 3:2/5:4/7:5/9:7 ratio with a trailing arc, coordinates and phase read out.

scenes.name: Field Lines
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: The rotating vector field F=(-y, x): a lattice quiver, 90 particles on closed orbits with tails, curl/divergence readouts and the formula.

scenes.name: Riemann Sum
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Left Riemann rectangles for f(x)=1.2+0.8 sin(x/1.8): n steps 4 to 48 and the area estimate converges to the analytic value with live error.

scenes.name: Bezier Mesh
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Three cubic Bezier meshes: dashed control polygons, live control points, a de Casteljau rider and the Bernstein formula.

scenes.name: Phase Portrait
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: The damped pendulum in phase space: 35 precomputed trajectories, a vector-field quiver and a rider with theta/omega/energy readouts.

scenes.name: Monte Carlo
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Estimating pi by throwing 3200 points at a square and its inscribed circle; the running 4*N_in/N estimate converges and resets.

scenes.name: Bifurcation
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: The logistic map attractor from r=2.5 to 4: period doubling into chaos, revealed column by column with the current r marked.

scenes.name: Descent Path
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Gradient descent into f=0.5(x^2/4+y^2): contour ellipses, downhill arrows, a 60-step path and loss/eta/step readouts.

scenes.name: Interference
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: Two coherent sources: expanding wavefront rings and an intensity lattice following cos(k dr - wt), with nodal lines drifting with phase.

scenes.name: Epicycle Veil
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: A chain of fifteen odd Fourier terms projects a square wave onto the time axis; the chain, the projection connector and a single-dot tracer share the palette.

scenes.name: Matrix Veil
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: A live linear map A(t) deforms the grid, the basis vectors and the unit square; the determinant is read out and a rider traces the image of a rotating point.

scenes.name: Kepler Veil
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: An eccentric orbit with the sun at the focus: the constant-time wedge widens near aphelion, and the radius and velocity vectors update live.

scenes.name: Complex Veil
scenes.author: xscriptor
scenes.description: The Argand diagram of the n-th roots of unity: rotating polygon, spokes, unit circle and a single-dot tail on the highlighted root, n stepping 3..12.
